desc: Derive the precise DP state for an unfinished upward chain and the conditions under which child states can be merged at a vertex.
Prove that any valid decomposition corresponds to the bottom-up DP decisions, ensuring no branching path is incorrectly accepted.
Implement iterative DFS/postorder traversal to avoid recursion-depth issues for up to \(2 \times 10^5\) vertices.
Implement special handling for \(K=1\), and verify the final root state has no unfinished chain.
Check complexity is \(O(NK)\) in vertices/edges overall.
